These figure examples appear here with only ids and file names changed: the one example in `README.md`, the four forms in `docs/get-started.qmd`, the gap example in `docs/width-gap.qmd`, the `wrap-lines` example in `docs/formats/latex.qmd`, and the slide example in `docs/formats/html.qmd`. The site's `wrap-clear` example is in `stop-rule.qmd`, its `wrapped:` example is in `defaults.qmd`, and its dashboard `.card` example has the shape of `fig-dash-card` in `dashboard.qmd`.
